items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: Sam Ray Orr, Orr has got things on the drum hall. Jack Keegan on the room used to come sit down and listen to him. He said, old man, that's it. He used to speak about, Trumma Young used to come follow us around all the time. He said, Orr, you got something.

ctx.x: Little St. Cyr I think was in the place.

Johnny St. Cyr, yeah. And they never, guys copy their records a day. Something that, even if they played a solo just like him, it's not those guys. Sam Ray Orr, Orr has got things on the drum hall. Jack Keegan on the room used to come sit down and listen to him. He said, old man, that's it. He used to speak about, Trumma Young used to come follow us around all the time. He said, Orr, you got something. What does this old man have? He said, the guys just had something happen. It was just what you call leaders. You…
I think Billie Holiday was that way as a singer.
